title: RabbitMQ: Exchanges, Routing, Acks
definition: Flexible message broker using exchanges and routing keys to decouple message producers from specific queues.

keyPoints.title: Exchanges & Routing
keyPoints.description: Direct, Fanout, and Topic wildcard (*, #) exchanges decouple publishers from consumers.

keyPoints.title: Acks & Requeue
keyPoints.description: Manual acknowledgments (ack, nack, reject) prevent message loss during processing failures.

keyPoints.title: Prefetch & QoS
keyPoints.description: Limits in-flight unacknowledged messages per worker, preventing consumer starvation.

recap: RabbitMQ exchanges messages ko routing keys aur binding rules ke basis par queues me push karte hain. Consumer acknowledgments (ack/nack) message loss rokte hain, jabki prefetch slow consumers ko overload hone se bachata hai.

demos.title: Exchange Routing Playground
demos.summary: Direct, Fanout, and Topic routing with live binding evaluation and DLX queues.
